# ArtX Creative Agency

> Design that makes brands unforgettable. A multidisciplinary creative agency designing brand identities, logos, websites and advertising for ambitious teams across Europe and beyond.

## About

ArtX Creative Agency was founded in 2019 and is based in Europe, working worldwide. We combine the craft of art with the variability of x — together, they're what we build every day.

- Slogan: Design that makes brands unforgettable.
- Founded: 2019
- Location: Europe (working worldwide)
- Contact: hello@artx.agency
- Website: https://artx.agency

## What we do

- [Brand Identity & Logo Design](https://artx.agency/#services): Identity systems that travel — wordmarks, monograms, type, color, motion and voice. Built to feel iconic from day one.
- [Web Design & Development](https://artx.agency/#services): From editorial single-pages to product platforms — high-craft sites that load fast, score 100 on Lighthouse, and convert.
- [Advertising Campaigns](https://artx.agency/#services): Campaigns rooted in the brand, expressed through every channel. Insight → big idea → distinctive creative → measurable lift.
- [Social, Motion & Strategy](https://artx.agency/#services): Bringing brands alive in feed — content systems, motion idents and story-driven shorts.

## AI automation for logistics

ArtX designs practical AI-powered workflows for logistics, transportation, freight forwarding, import/export and supply-chain companies, built around the systems they already use. We do not replace a client's technology stack.

- [AI Automation for Logistics Operations](https://artx.agency/logistics-automation): Automate repetitive work across email, documents, spreadsheets, customer requests and internal systems.
- Service pillars: Workflow Automation · Document and Email Processing · AI-Assisted Customer Operations
- Common use cases: automated RFQ processing, shipment status requests, document data extraction, email classification and routing, CRM and spreadsheet updates, customer and supplier follow-ups, operations reporting, internal knowledge assistant.
- Typical clients: freight forwarders, transportation companies, third-party logistics providers, warehousing, customs services, distribution and e-commerce logistics teams of 10 to 250 employees.
- Engagement model: free workflow audit, then a focused pilot on one high-volume workflow. Pilots may often be delivered in two to six weeks depending on complexity, integrations and approvals — an indication, not a guarantee.
- Human oversight: approval steps are kept wherever accuracy, cost or customer communication matters.
- Request a free workflow audit: https://artx.agency/logistics-automation#lead-form
